WMAK.description: Wall Mark (WMAK). Groups a set of walls under a named mark; each key is the wall mark id and its value carries the mark name and the list of wall element ids it contains.

MARKNAME.description: Wall mark name. Trailing whitespace is trimmed. Must be unique across all wall marks (duplicate names are rejected).

WID_LIST.description: List of wall element ids belonging to this wall mark. Assigning replaces the entire existing list.
